status_note: Weights chosen autonomously per Ben's 2026-11-04 directive item 7 (normalize, bounded sensitivity checks, documented choice; no pause for approval). Every term and weight is re-read by fr_objective at every solve; this file is the only place weights live. Rationale per term in weight_sensitivity log + README. Any weight here can be replaced by Ben at any time; the re-solve is checkpoint-based. | 2026-11-04 signed-deficit correction applied after the figure review caught opposite-sign robot curves.

terms.name: torque_capacity_deficit
terms.normalization: sum_tau_target_abs (sum over the pose grid of |tau_target|)
terms.definition: sum over pose grid of max(0, |tau_target| - proj), where proj = tau_primary * sign(tau_target): the SIGNED meet-or-beat deficit. A wrong-sign torque projects negative and costs |tau_target| + |tau_robot| - strictly more than producing nothing (Ben 2026-11-04: opposite sign from the human target will not do).
terms.sign_convention: same-axis signed convention; wrong-sign torque is penalized, never credited toward the meet

terms.name: usable_rom_shortfall
terms.normalization: grid size (fraction of poses, so the term lives in [0,1])
terms.definition: fraction of pose-grid cells where |tau_primary| < |tau_target| (usable motion range primary, master item 8); report-only companion: fraction of cells feasible

terms.name: torque_shape
terms.normalization: mean over grid of (tau_primary - tau_target)^2 / mean(tau_target.^2)
terms.definition: small, explicitly weighted torque-shape penalty (master item 8): squared residual to the SIGNED target curve. Defined SEPARATELY from the capacity terms; its small weight guarantees it cannot remove the deficit incentive. Never an off-axis torque term.
terms.sensitivity: ±2x perturbation leaves the chosen designs unchanged within solver noise (weight_sensitivity log)

terms.name: bpa_bpa_overlap_soft
terms.normalization: sleeve inflated diameter at rest per pose (depth reported in mm as well)
terms.definition: soft BPA-BPA interference (handoff item 9 / master item 8): summed overlap depth between the group's OWN parallel BPA sleeves from the pose-dependent inflated envelopes, physically simultaneous poses only. Depth and extent reported per pose.

terms.name: retained_bpa_corridor_soft
terms.normalization: sleeve inflated diameter at rest per pose (extent reported in mm as well)
terms.definition: v2 (Ben 2026-11-04): soft interference against RETAINED INNER-LAYER BPA sleeve corridors (fr_envelope kind 'bpa_sleeve'/'bpa_end'), evaluated at physically simultaneous poses. Depth/extent recorded every evaluation. An outer-layer BPA is never INFEASIBLE for crossing an inner layer's sleeve corridor - it pays this penalty; rigid fittings and tackle blocks of inner layers stay HARD (retained_rigid_envelopes).

forbidden: off_axis_torque_penalty in ANY form, including inherited regularizers disguised as another term (master item 8; handoff item 9). Secondary joint torques are RECORDED in the evaluation report and never penalized.
any hard universal muscle-to-muscle clearance constraint (BPA-BPA overlap is soft; only rigid hardware/bone and the z=0 centerline are hard)

enforcing inner-layer BPA SLEEVE corridors as a HARD clearance constraint (Ben 2026-11-04: that was the stage-1 layering demo's unintended hard BPA-BPA constraint; rigid fittings/tackle of inner layers remain hard)

hard_constraints.name: centerline_z0
hard_constraints.definition: sideSign * z_pelvis >= 0 for EVERY candidate attachment point and mechanical mount anchor, transformed into the pelvis frame at EVERY evaluated pose (handoff item 8, verbatim). sideSign = +1 (right side of record). Sign flips / absolute values forbidden. Tolerance 1e-4 m, stated per evaluation in rep.cinfo.

hard_constraints.name: foot_occupancy_ban
hard_constraints.definition: No BPA body, end fitting, or tackle block may occupy the foot (talus_r, calcn_r, toes_r). Tendons may route through and terminate on the foot. Enforced by owning-body membership of sleeve/fitting/tackle anchors plus the fitting-tip position rule on the tibia. Tolerance 1e-4 m, stated per evaluation.

hard_constraints.name: required_tendon_spans
hard_constraints.definition: minFootTendonSpan_m and minKneeTendonSpan_m computed by fr_spans from the route geometry + hardware clearance over the full motion range (contract placeholders resolved by the implementer, master item 6). Tendon length must cover the maximum required span. Normalized by the procured hardware length; tolerance 1e-6, stated per evaluation.

hard_constraints.name: transmission_feasibility
hard_constraints.definition: no PulleyInfeasible or PulleySlack cell on the required grid; strain within [strain floor, KMAX]; gain <= tackle line parts; at most ONE tackle (BiPam_pulley2 documented limit); discrete config consistent (nBPA, series sections, physical sheave count, reeving kept distinct). Cell-fraction normalizations; tolerances 1e-12, stated per evaluation.

hard_constraints.name: rated_hardware_loads
hard_constraints.definition: tackle-block vector reaction R and any 180-deg reversing sheave radial load 2T must not exceed the assigned family's catalog capacity (S 400 N / M 667 N / L 3003 N). Catalog capacities are weight capacities whose dynamic interpretation is UNRESOLVED (handoff Open items); the assembly WLL is not assumed. Under-rated configurations are flagged in the report, never silently resized. Normalized by capacity; tolerance 1e-6, stated per evaluation.

hard_constraints.name: bone_exclusion
hard_constraints.definition: route clearance to the owning bones (clouds today; packaging_v2 SDF model with quantified registration error when it lands) >= inflated radius + rigid clearance. Tolerance 1e-4 m, stated per evaluation.

hard_constraints.name: retained_rigid_envelopes
hard_constraints.definition: v2: rigid fittings and tackle blocks of already-placed deeper layers (fr_envelope kind 'rigid_*') as hard obstacles at physically simultaneous poses. BPA sleeve corridors of inner layers are the SOFT term retained_bpa_corridor_soft instead (Ben 2026-11-04). Tolerance 1e-4 m, stated per evaluation.
